outgoing.name: Austria
outgoing.excerpt: Hugo Wolf ( March 13, 1860 – February 22, 1903) was an Austrian composer of Slovene origin, particularly noted for his art songs, or Lieder.

outgoing.name: Opera
outgoing.excerpt: Wolf wrote hundreds of Lieder, three operas, incidental music, choral music, as well as some rarely-heard orchestral, chamber and piano music.
